config.sublang.title: SubLang Configuration
config.sublang.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable the bilingual item name display
config.sublang.sourceLanguage.tooltip: Language code to show in parentheses (e.g., en_us)
config.sublang.format.tooltip: Format string for bilingual display. {current} = current language, {source} = source language, \n = newline
config.sublang.showForSame.tooltip: Show source language even when translation is the same
config.sublang.excludedMods.tooltip: List of mod IDs to exclude from bilingual display
config.sublang.excludedItems.tooltip: List of item IDs to exclude (e.g., minecraft:diamond)
